question: What alternative substance can the wise practitioner unify as equivalent to the previous rite?
premises: The wise practitioner unifies his own five-limb impurity.
inference: The practitioner's own five-limb impurity can be used as an equivalent substance.
uncertainties: The exact referents of 'five-limb impurity' are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: As an equivalent to this, the very wise person brings his own five-limb impurity to oneness.
